symptom: Video decode stays at full GPU after the sampler finishes and never writes the file.
root_cause: MiniMax H3 video VAE step wedged twice on this shot, including after a clean ComfyUI restart.
fix: Restart ComfyUI, then retry once with a new seed to a new filename. If decode stalls past two minutes, stop and use a side track from the still.
prevention: If the H3 log stops on MiniMaxH3VideoVAE for over two minutes, restart ComfyUI before the next shot.
